meta.title: PWA Toolbox — Browser capability sandbox
meta.description: A sandbox for testing installability, offline support, background sync, notifications, geolocation, Bluetooth, USB, share target, clipboard, file system, network and badging APIs.

shareTarget.title: Share target
shareTarget.description: Payload received from the operating system share sheet.

dashboard.title: PWA Toolbox
dashboard.description: Twelve isolated cards for probing what the current browser actually supports. Every API is feature-checked after mount, every action reports its own result, and unsupported capabilities say so instead of failing silently.
dashboard.notesBody: Service worker generation is wired through Serwist in next.config.ts; this build does not register a worker, so background sync and push degrade to in-page behaviour. Geolocation, clipboard, Bluetooth, USB, file access and badging require a secure origin and, in several cases, an installed app.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist in the selected language.

shareTargetPage.title: Share target
shareTargetPage.description: This route receives the title, text and url parameters declared in manifest.share_target.

install.title: Installability
install.description: Capture the browser’s install prompt and detect whether the app is already running in standalone mode.
install.footnote: The prompt only fires over HTTPS with a valid manifest, icons and a registered service worker.
install.installed: Installed — this window is already running as a standalone app.
install.unsupported: This browser does not support programmatic installation. On iOS use Share → “Add to Home Screen”; Firefox installs through its own menu.
install.waiting: Waiting for the browser to fire beforeinstallprompt. It usually needs a reload over HTTPS and a satisfied install criteria check.
install.whyDisabledNotice: Installability needs a service worker and a manifest served over HTTPS.
install.accepted: Install accepted — the browser is adding the app to your device.
install.dismissed: Install dismissed. The browser decides when to offer the prompt again.

offline.title: Offline support
offline.description: Track connectivity in real time and inspect what the service worker has actually cached for offline use.
offline.footnote: Fetch strategies are generated by Serwist at build time; this card only reports what is live.
offline.noticeOffline: Offline. Pages already cached by the service worker keep working; uncached routes fail until the connection returns.
offline.noticeNoWorker: No service worker is registered in this environment, so nothing is cached yet.

sync.title: Background sync
sync.description: Queue messages in IndexedDB while offline, ask the service worker for a background sync, and flush to a mock endpoint once the connection returns.
sync.savedOnline: Saved to IndexedDB. You are online — press “Sync now” to send it.
sync.savedOfflineWithSync: Saved to IndexedDB. Background sync “{tag}” registered; the service worker will flush it.
sync.savedOfflineNoSync: Saved to IndexedDB. Background sync is unavailable here, so this card flushes the queue when the connection returns.
sync.flushed: {count, plural, =0 {The queue is already empty.} one {Sent # item and cleared the queue.} other {Sent # items and cleared the queue.}}
sync.flushedOnReconnect: {count, plural, one {Connection restored — flushed # pending item to {endpoint}.} other {Connection restored — flushed # pending items to {endpoint}.}}
sync.noticeUnsupported: IndexedDB or fetch is unavailable, so offline queueing cannot run in this browser.

push.title: Push notifications
push.description: Request notification permission, inspect the current permission state, and fire a local test notification.
push.footnote: Real push needs a VAPID key, a push subscription and a push handler in the service worker.
push.noticeUnsupported: The Notification API is missing. iOS Safari only exposes it for installed home-screen apps.
push.noticeDenied: Permission is blocked for this origin. Reset it from the padlock menu in the address bar.
push.grantedMessage: Permission granted. Send a test notification.
push.deniedMessage: Permission denied. Re-enable notifications in the browser’s site settings.
push.dismissedMessage: Permission was dismissed without a choice.
push.sentViaConstructor: Notification created with the Notification constructor.
push.unsupportedError: Notifications are not supported in this browser.

geo.title: Geolocation
geo.description: Request a one-shot position fix with high accuracy and inspect the reported coordinates and accuracy radius.
geo.footnote: Requires a secure origin; browsers only ask once per session and remember the answer per origin.
geo.errorDenied: Permission denied — allow location access for this origin and try again.
geo.errorUnavailable: Position unavailable — the device could not determine a location.
geo.errorTimeout: Timed out while waiting for a position fix.
geo.noticeUnsupported: Geolocation is not available, so coordinates cannot be read.

bluetooth.title: Web Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Scan for a nearby BLE peripheral, connect to its GATT server and inspect the selected device identity.
bluetooth.footnote: Chromium on desktop and Android only — Safari and Firefox do not implement Web Bluetooth.
bluetooth.noGatt: Device selected, but no GATT server is available.
bluetooth.unavailable: Web Bluetooth is not available in this browser.
bluetooth.noticeUnsupported: Web Bluetooth is not supported here (iOS, Safari and Firefox never expose it). Use Chrome or Edge on desktop or Android.

usb.title: WebUSB
usb.description: Pick a USB device with the browser chooser, open it, select its first configuration and read its descriptors.
usb.footnote: Chromium desktop only — Safari, Firefox and mobile browsers do not implement WebUSB.
usb.unavailable: WebUSB is not available in this browser.
usb.noticeUnsupported: WebUSB is not supported here. Use Chrome or Edge on desktop with a device that exposes a compatible interface.

share.title: Share target
share.description: Receive a link, text or file from the operating system share sheet and render it on a dedicated route.
share.footnote: Registered in public/manifest.json as a GET share target → /share-target
share.notice: Install the app, then share a link from another app and pick “PWA Toolbox”. Shared values arrive as query parameters.
share.noticeUnsupported: This browser exposes neither the Web Share API nor a service worker, so the share sheet will not list the app.

view.title: Title
view.emptyNotice: No share data in the query string. Try the “Simulate a share” link on the dashboard, or share a link from another app to this installed PWA.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.description: Write text to the system clipboard and read it back. Both directions surface permission and security errors.
clipboard.footnote: Reading requires a user gesture plus clipboard-read permission in most browsers.
clipboard.label: Text to copy
clipboard.copied: Copied {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} to the clipboard.
clipboard.errorDenied: Clipboard access denied. Grant permission in site settings and keep the tab focused.
clipboard.errorSecurity: Clipboard access requires a secure (HTTPS) context.
clipboard.errorEmpty: The clipboard is empty or contains no text.
clipboard.noticeUnsupported: The async Clipboard API is unavailable. This usually means an insecure origin or an older browser.

fileSystem.title: File system access
fileSystem.description: Open a local text file into the editor below and write it back through a FileSystemWritableFileStream.
fileSystem.footnote: Chromium desktop only; requires a secure context and a direct user gesture.
fileSystem.placeholder: Open a file, or type text here and save it.
fileSystem.truncated: Preview truncated to the first {count} characters; saving writes the truncated text.
fileSystem.unavailable: The File System Access API is not available.
fileSystem.noticeUnsupported: The File System Access API is unavailable here. Safari, Firefox and all mobile browsers lack it — use Chrome or Edge on desktop.

network.title: Network information
network.description: Watch connectivity events and read the Network Information API’s estimate of the current connection.
network.footnote: effectiveType and rtt are coarse estimates; Firefox and Safari expose little beyond navigator.onLine.
network.events: {count, plural, =0 {No change events yet} one {# change event} other {# change events}}
network.noApi: The Network Information API is not exposed by this browser — only the online/offline flag is available.
network.noticeUnsupported: navigator.onLine is unavailable, so connectivity cannot be reported.

badge.title: App badging
badge.description: Set or clear the numeric badge on the installed app icon — useful for unread counts.
badge.footnote: Supported on Chromium (desktop and Android) for installed PWAs; iOS Safari ignores it.
badge.errorRejected: The badge was rejected. Install the app first (badging needs an installed PWA).
badge.errorUnsupported: This platform does not display app badges.
badge.errorInvalid: Enter a whole number of 0 or greater.
badge.unavailable: The Badging API is not available.
badge.noticeUnsupported: navigator.setAppBadge is unavailable. Badging requires an installed PWA on a supporting platform.
